name: 到期管家
description: Track recurring due dates and Apple Reminders with compact widgets, safe completion history, local backups, optional notifications, and checked updates.

localizedDescriptions.en: 2.5.4 recognizes Card Setup, VentureOne and related credit-card actions from Apple Reminder titles, with Wallet Plan as an exact List fallback. Strict word boundaries prevent similar unrelated titles from matching. Existing data, layouts, language behavior and notifications are unchanged.
localizedDescriptions.zh: 2.5.4 补齐 Apple 提醒事项中的 Card Setup、VentureOne 及相关信用卡操作标题识别，并将完整 List 名 Wallet Plan 作为分类后备。严格边界可避免相近无关标题误判；现有数据、布局、语言和通知逻辑不变。

localizedDescriptions.zh-Hant: 2.5.4 補齊 Apple 提醒事項中的 Card Setup、VentureOne 及相關信用卡操作標題識別，並將完整 List 名 Wallet Plan 作為分類後備。嚴格邊界可避免相近無關標題誤判；現有資料、版面、語言和通知邏輯不變。
